description: Publishes a new static site or a new version of one. New: every file, or a template. Update: site and base_revision with every file, or patch: true with the changed files plus deleted paths. A first publish without an account returns site_token and claim_url.

encoding.description: utf8 (default) for text, base64 for images and other binaries

path.description: Relative path, e.g. index.html or assets/app.js

idempotency_key.description: New sites: a fresh random value (e.g. a UUID); a retry with the same key and files replays the first result

patch.description: true: files are only the changed ones

site_token.description: site_token from the first deploy (anonymous sites only)

template.description: Template name, e.g. "brasa": its files become the site (files given replace those paths); then patch-deploy edits

workspace.description: New sites: this workspace (id or name from get_account) or "private" (the person's own personal site). Omitted: the only place the site can go; when it could be personal or in a workspace (or one of several), nothing is published and the reply asks the user which

name: deploy
title: Publish site
